title: The Observatory Watch
premise: A public observatory is sheltering neighbors while its night observers search for a rescue signal.
opening: Leaves press against silent windows. The night crew has one route to the roof.

entries.description: A brass magnifying glass encloses a crisp violet star.
Two colleagues photographed together beside a windswept waterfront railing.
A botanical sketch shows three broad leaves growing above a terracotta pot.
A telescope points toward the upper-right corner from a splayed tripod.
A pale crescent moon rests against a dark field.
A rust planet sits inside a tilted golden ring.
A five-pointed amber star stands alone on navy paper.
Ochre graffiti forms a tent-like arch beneath a small rust-red sun.
A domed observatory stands beneath a sparse cluster of stars.
A hand-drawn planning diagram connects three colored work areas in a triangular loop.
A white comet trails three blue streaks toward the bottom-left.
A tiny red moon follows an oval path around a green world.
A violet galaxy coils around a bright yellow nucleus.
A triangular prism splits one pale beam into red, green and blue rays.
Square solar panels flank a small silver satellite.
A clock face shows a long upward hand and a short hand aimed left.
Two round eyepieces are joined by a narrow bridge.
Colored bands climb from cool blue through green to warm orange.
Curved signal marks radiate from a red-tipped aerial.
A dark meteor cuts across an orange wedge of flame.
A crosshair marks one square inside a pale blue observation grid.
A black disk eclipses most of a yellow sun, leaving a thin rim.
